_notes: graph-aim-walks (docs/snap/walks-plan.md). THIS ARTIFACT IS NOT PRIVATE: the base graph-AIM artifact is the v2 config (base_config, a path relative to this file) fitted with noise = false, and the walk tables (n_walks walks of spec.length steps, starts uniform over nodes of degree >= 1, pool seeded with the stage-1 seed) and the top spectrum_k eigenvalues of the walk matrix D^-1 A are exact statistics of the real graph. It answers a research question (privacy set aside, can a generator that only sees walk tables produce graphs whose walks look real?) and must never be presented as a DP release. share_attrs 'all' = every attribute of the schema. Groups, dominance pairs and degree bins were chosen by looking at the real graph (the strongest homophily attributes and their joint).
